title: Compact the closed statuses
prompt: The invoices table is partitioned by status, and every daily load adds a file to each status. Paid and void invoices never change, so billing wants those partitions compacted tonight, while the others are still being written to. Finish `compact_closed`.
rules: Compact the `paid` and `void` partitions into as few files as OPTIMIZE makes.
Leave every other partition as it is, including invoices with no status.
hints: Run the starter: each status has three files, one per load.
`optimize().where(...)` compacts only the partitions its condition matches. The condition is SQL text on the partition column.
Two statuses: join two comparisons with `OR`, or use `IN`. And remember the builder does nothing until you execute the compaction.
explanation: `DeltaTable.forPath(spark, path).optimize().where("status IN ('paid', 'void')").executeCompaction()` picks the two partitions and packs each one's three files into one; `status = 'paid' OR status = 'void'` works the same. Every other partition keeps its three files, and so does the partition of invoices with no status: a NULL status matches neither value. Compacting the whole table touches partitions that are still being written to, and leaving out `executeCompaction()` builds the compaction without running it. When neither status has any invoices, the condition matches no partition and OPTIMIZE does nothing.
